# Recorded LLM answers

Real answers from a Claude chat (claude.ai), saved verbatim. Tests replay them offline, so the
prompt-and-check pipeline is tested against what a real model actually returns.

| file | prompt | date |
|---|---|---|
| `titanic_claude_chat_reply.json` | `automl prompt data/titanic.csv --describe "Predict which passengers survived the Titanic disaster" --target survived` (OpenML titanic v1) | 2026-11-04 |
